$comment: Gate B DRAFT rule object for RF-SEV-001 — pending, NON-EXECUTABLE. Authored only from RF Clinical Rule Specification v1.2 §9.2 and the RF-SEV-001 inventory entry. Clinical-content-only rule: cites evidence claims and has NO architecture references (architecture_refs intentionally empty per v1.2 §4.3). Expresses guarded group-context / classification-record STRUCTURE only: a valid Munich muscle-injury classification may structure the record and provide population-limited group-level context. It is NOT RF-specific validation; imaging-negative or functional categories must not be equated with no injury; medians must not become individual timelines. No diagnosis, prognosis engine, phase selection, rehab, dosage, progression, confidence, or return-to-sport logic; safety precedence preserved. Not approved. Not wired into any runtime.
rule_title: Munich classification for guarded group context

input_contract.$comment: Structural classification input taken verbatim-in-meaning from v1.2 §9.2. Only a valid Munich classification (from a report or verified assessment) is recorded; it structures the record and provides group-level context only.

decision_contract.$comment: Guarded group-context structure only. Classification records context; it is not RF-specific validation, does not equate imaging-negative/functional categories with no injury, and does not turn medians into individual timelines. No phase selection, rehab authorization, prognosis engine, or numeric values. Safety precedence preserved.

notes: Clinical_content normative source; MAY; permitted_use logic_with_uncertainty. Architecture references are intentionally empty: per v1.2 §4.3 clinical-content rules cite valid evidence_claim_ids and do not carry architecture refs (none are present in the §9.2 source); [] means 'none in source', not 'missing'. Evidence grades preserved per source: QRF-007 (D2), QRF-011 (D2). Per §9.2: a valid Munich classification may structure the record and provide population-limited group-level context. Limits preserved exactly: it is NOT RF-specific validation; imaging-negative or functional categories must NOT be equated with no injury; medians must NOT become individual timelines. Cohort medians and group benchmarks remain group context only, never an individual prediction; the rule does not assign confidence/probability, determine rehab phase, authorize rehab, produce a complete plan, or produce a return-to-sport decision, and does not override safety, current capacity, external restrictions, stage, readiness, or concurrent-injury constraints. Uncertainty is preserved when classification source quality is weak, absent, user-entered without source, or unclear. Severity rule, not a safety rule, so safety_state_output is null and blocked_targets is empty; safety precedence preserved. No severity/prognosis model is authored here (deferred to the later severity and readiness objects). Draft — approval_status remains pending.
